verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a sanctioned machine rail, the Torch developer platform. It offers a Case Status API and a FOIA/PA request-creation API, and its enrollment path is documented: register a developer account, form a team, build in the sandbox, pass a demo, then receive production keys. However, the core transaction of filing applications has no system-to-system channel; online filing is only through the myUSCIS human account. missing for 10: a filing/submission API or batch/transmitter program for forms, system accounts covering the main transactions (filing, fee payment, G-28 representation), independent or hands-on corroboration of the Torch onboarding flow.
